selection: Empty-context public questions only, 8..70 words, no listed competing format terms; exact dev-text and pairwise token-Jaccard >.85 exclusions. First 960 from seeded order. Four consecutive questions per bundle; round-robin rule assignment.
scope: MT-Eval rule/checker adaptation, not an official MT-Eval benchmark score. Bundles are constructed conversations, not original Dolly dialogues. No model outputs used in selection.
